import sys

def main():
    line = None
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            raise RuntimeError()
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            break
    s = line
    ans = 0
    i = len(s) - 1
    while i >= 0:
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and s[j] == s[i]:
            j -= 1
        if (i - j) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        raise RuntimeError()
